metric: Pinocchio median time per call / Dynibo median time per call; values above one favor Dynibo
scope: Single-state Jacobian, RNEA and ABA with no external loads. Floating-base ABA uses an unactuated base without contact constraints. Batch FK and reusable-load results are separate workloads, recorded in staged-2026-10-09.json.

rust.run_command: LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PINOCCHIO_PREFIX/lib" OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 2 <executable from build JSON> --bench --save-baseline readme-20261009
rust.output_api: Caller-owned output buffers; Pinocchio C++ functions called through the repository FFI bridge, including output copy. Coordinate reordering for validation is outside timing.

python_build_command: python3 -m pip wheel . --no-build-isolation --no-deps --wheel-dir <wheel-dir>; python3 -m pip install --no-deps --target <installed-wheel> <wheel>
python_run_command: PYTHONPATH=<installed-wheel> LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PINOCCHIO_PREFIX/lib" OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 benches/python.py --cpu 2 --samples 30 --batch-seconds 0.02 --output <report.json>
